scope.comparison_bound: The frozen mt121 authority was compared only with Fremlin's current official Chapter 12 TeX and official Volume 1 errata. Prior local correction and terminology records were read only for consistency.

volume_1_errata.relevant_entry: p. 44 l. 13, part (a-i) of the proof of 121K: replace the one-dimensional complement by the r-dimensional complement

definitions.ocint: line 531: open at the left endpoint and closed at the right endpoint

comparison_summary.interpretation: The current official mt121 text is otherwise line-for-line identical to the frozen authority. Consequently, the remaining suspected defects below are still present in the current source and are not claimed to be official corrections.

corroborated_defects.authority_context: E is a subset of R^r, but the conclusion uses R setminus E.
corroborated_defects.proposed_translation_treatment: Use the dimension-correct R^r complement, preserve the proof structure, and ledger the derivative change as a source mathematical correction.
corroborated_defects.upstream_reason: Already fixed in the current official source and explicitly listed in the official errata.

suspected_high_confidence_defects.authority_context: For non-decreasing g, E={x:g(x)<a} is said to be D intersection ]-infinity,c[ or D intersection ]-infinity,c], according to whether c is in E or not. The positional pairing is reversed: membership of c requires the right-closed interval.
suspected_high_confidence_defects.mathematical_check: If c is in E, monotonicity gives E=D intersection ]-infinity,c]; if c is not in E, E=D intersection ]-infinity,c[.
suspected_high_confidence_defects.official_errata_status: not found among the Section 121 entries
suspected_high_confidence_defects.proposed_translation_treatment: State the two cases explicitly in the mathematically correct order rather than reproducing the ambiguous/reversed positional clause.

suspected_high_confidence_defects.authority_context: The function is defined throughout the clause as liminf with n tending to infinity, but the concluding sentence alone writes liminf with n in N.
suspected_high_confidence_defects.internal_evidence: All neighboring definitions, conclusions, proof formulae, 121H, and 121Xc use n tending to infinity for limsup/liminf.
suspected_high_confidence_defects.official_errata_status: not found among the Section 121 entries
suspected_high_confidence_defects.proposed_translation_treatment: Normalize the concluding display to n tending to infinity; this changes no mathematical content and removes a local notation discontinuity.

suspected_high_confidence_defects.authority_context: The source writes sum from k=1 to infinity of |a_k| + |b_k| = infinity without parentheses, leaving b_k visually outside the explicit scope of the summation and its k free under a strict parse.
suspected_high_confidence_defects.intended_form: sum from k=1 to infinity of (|a_k|+|b_k|) = infinity
suspected_high_confidence_defects.official_errata_status: not found among the Section 121 entries
suspected_high_confidence_defects.proposed_translation_treatment: Add grouping parentheses around |a_k|+|b_k| while preserving the intended non-absolute-summability statement.

suspected_high_confidence_defects.authority_context: The coordinate expansion begins with phi_i and ends with phi_r, although i is the running coordinate index in the preceding phrase and the full vector must begin with phi_1.
suspected_high_confidence_defects.official_errata_status: not found among the Section 121 entries
suspected_high_confidence_defects.proposed_translation_treatment: Use phi_1 as the first coordinate and ledger the derivative change as a mathematical index correction.

deliberate_house_notation_and_nondefects.surface: partially defined functions and dom f
deliberate_house_notation_and_nondefects.treatment: Do not silently totalize functions. Preserve every stated domain, intersection of domains, and the restrictive eventually-defined convention for limits.

deliberate_house_notation_and_nondefects.assessment: juxtaposition denotes composition h after f, not multiplication
deliberate_house_notation_and_nondefects.treatment: Translate as composition and retain the source-defined domain of hf.

deliberate_house_notation_and_nondefects.assessment: denotes pointwise multiplication of real-valued functions, not a Cartesian product
deliberate_house_notation_and_nondefects.treatment: Use pointwise-product language where prose could otherwise be ambiguous.

deliberate_house_notation_and_nondefects.assessment: ooint is open-open and ocint is open-closed by fremtex.tex
deliberate_house_notation_and_nondefects.treatment: Preserve endpoint topology exactly. This macro evidence is also what exposes O007-S121-SRC-002.

deliberate_house_notation_and_nondefects.surface: unions indexed only by q<a in 121I
deliberate_house_notation_and_nondefects.assessment: q is implicitly rational because E_q was defined only for q in Q
deliberate_house_notation_and_nondefects.treatment: Preserve the mathematics; natural prose may restate the rational index to prevent a free-index reading.

deliberate_house_notation_and_nondefects.surface: the one-anchor Cauchy coding with G_mnk in 121H
deliberate_house_notation_and_nondefects.assessment: equivalent to the usual pairwise Cauchy criterion after a harmless epsilon rescaling
deliberate_house_notation_and_nondefects.treatment: Do not report or alter it as a source defect.

deliberate_house_notation_and_nondefects.assessment: idiosyncratic source diction immediately glossed by the author
deliberate_house_notation_and_nondefects.treatment: Translate naturally as equivalent, keeping the explanatory gloss rather than inventing an Indonesian cognate.

deliberate_house_notation_and_nondefects.assessment: Fremlin's indexing includes 0 in this corpus
deliberate_house_notation_and_nondefects.treatment: Retain N and ensure any reader-facing glossary says that 0 is included; avoid relying on the ambiguous Indonesian convention for bilangan asli.

terminology_recommendations.hazard: Do not confuse the predicate with measurable space (ruang terukur) or measurable set (himpunan terukur).

terminology_recommendations.basis: Extends the established aljabar-sigma and ukuran subruang pattern.
Parallel to the established terukur Lebesgue.

terminology_recommendations.hazard: f^{-1}[E] is a set preimage, not an inverse function.
The source often writes hf rather than h circle f.

terminology_recommendations.source_term: supremum / infimum / limit superior / limit inferior
terminology_recommendations.target_term: supremum / infimum / limit superior / limit inferior
terminology_recommendations.hazard: Keep sup, inf, limsup, and liminf distinct and preserve their partially-defined domains.

release_and_upstream_policy.future_report: After the complete assigned corpus and separate authorization, retain only the unresolved high-confidence items for one concise deduplicated report; omit O007-S121-SRC-001 because upstream has already corrected it.
